rust_summary: looking up translated registry names and content namespace owners (`native_display_name`, `native_owner_mod`).
doc_summary: `display_name(registry, id)` returns a current-language name for items, blocks, entity types, effects and enchantments, with the pinned English fallback when available. Missing non-item translations and unsupported registries return the ID. `owner_mod(namespace)` returns the active content owner's `(id, manifest name)`, Minecraft for `minecraft`, or `None` when unknown. Bundles need fragment @API:registry_names@.
